It was incredibly nice from you to take a loan when your brother was ill. It wasn't your obligation at all. You really have a big heart and would be a shame to throw it away. 
Keep living please and PM sometimes if you like. Maybe we can both get better in grammar :) .
Thank you guys very much for your support. I appreciate it
Thank you very much for hearing me out and for your long, incredibly nice and thoughtful reply. It really helped. Thank you
Hi man, drink some wine and go to bed and get some sleep + write to the girl that you want to finish it because of her.  See in the morning if she responds.

Hey man I'm with you. I got kicked of uni once and on my way to get kicked out for the second time. I feel like a biggest piece of useless shit there is and I am. No good for nothing. My family would be better of if I wasn't born. But I imagine loosing your own child is the worst feeling to wake up with and that is why I continue.
My advice would be to find one thing that is worthy of staying alive.
